text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening. After accompanying Tokai Teio on a shopping trip,
we were walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Looks like people are gathering
up ahead? What is it, what is it~?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you two who look like parent and child!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We are NOT mother and daughter!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A raffle lottery, huh~? Ehehe,
I'm super good at these kinds of things, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've hit the jackpot multiple times in a row before, and people were like, "You're crazy lucky!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! I got a ticket from the game shop,
so let's go draw together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's grab the lever together and spin it round and round!
Co-op mode, activate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio and I spun the lottery wheel together,
fervently wishing for a win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now, as for the result—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, the grand prize~~~!?
Yay yay yay, yaaaay!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, didn't I tell you?
I'm super good at this kind of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How's that, ta-da! Hmph, so there~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio skipped around innocently.
She seemed to be exceptionally happy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, who should I use this hot spring trip voucher with...
If I'm taking someone, it's gotta be them, of course!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, totally!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah, yeah...
Still, though~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to be the president...? 
I'm starting to lose confidence...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I just swore at my New Year's shrine visit
that I'd surpass the Prez, so going to a hot spring together feels a bit...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: This is no time for that right now, and I feel like the President wouldn't give the okay anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As she grew stronger, a slight change
seemed to emerge in Tokai Teio's mindset as well."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, can I leave this hot spring trip voucher
with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Right now, there's a lot I don't understand, so I want to go after things settle down with the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"With whoever seems like they'd be the most fun to visit a hot spring with.
Got it?"
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll hold onto it for you!
Got it, I'll hold onto it for you then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, count me in! Hopefully, by then,
I'll have become the Empress of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then everyone—from the hot spring inn's landlady to the chefs—
welcomed me chanting, "It's Lady Teio! It's Lady Teio!"
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to give me an extra-large serving of sashimi!
And don't forget the rubber duckies for the open-air bath!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dreaming of receiving a hero's welcome. With more to look forward to in her future, Tokai Teio's motivation rose considerably.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First prize!? So close~~~!!
Still, this is pretty great too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks soo delicious~!
The sauce is all nice and thick too~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer, did you just think having a taste for hamburg steaks means I have a childish palate?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, thinking like that is what's childish, you know?
Everybody loves hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since we're making it,
let's put a fried egg on top too!
Let's make a fried egg hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them ate fried egg hamburg steaks together.
While eating, Tokai Teio wore a smile brighter and more innocent than any child's.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Second prize, huh. I feel like I could've gone a bit further,
but well, I guess that's how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, but that's a crazy amount! With this
much, there's gotta be a good way to use it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know!
Let's throw a carrot party!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, let's gather our friends! Then we
can chat, play games, and have a ton of fun—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She does comedy bits and acrobatics too!
Plus magic tricks and quizzes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow, that looks like funー!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Carrots? Ah, right.
I eat them when I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The carrots were just a bonus.
Seems they just wanted to make a racket.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go, Trainer!
Let's party! Ah, with carrots!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, that mountain of carrots
became a source of fun for Tokai Teio
and ended up in everyone's stomachs.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, just one~?
Give me at least two~!
One for me and one for Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although a protest was lodged, it was not upheld,
resulting in a finish of just one run.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tch~, only one, huh~?
Maybe I should at least do something before eating it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
I'll copy the President's pose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Tokai Teio held a single carrot high up toward the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Did you get what that was
an appeal for just now? Trainer.
choice_data_list: Bragging about winning the first leg of the Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's not it~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win next time too! So, I'm making it clear
that I'll need 2 carrots for that!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So mister,
give me one more skewer.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: No, you can't.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then three reps.
I'll do the Triple Crown Carrot Umamusume routine too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't even know why anymore.
In the end, Tokai Teio munched down the single carrot in one bite.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gaaasp!
I'm... pocket tissue~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Where did your usual good luck go~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be, Trainer,
that you're on the unluckier side?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see~. I don't really get it,
but I guess today just wasn't my lucky day...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's forget it in a snap. Remembering it will
only make you feel bad, so here's a tissue...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is feeling unusually down.
It seems everyone has unlucky days.
